versions.changelog:
Initial release of EdrawMax Diagram skill.

- Generate flowcharts, infographics, Gantt charts, or mind maps from natural language descriptions using EdrawMax AI APIs.
- Automatically detects user intent or asks for clarification if ambiguous.
- Downloads generated PNG/SVG diagrams for local access, and provides both image paths and source code to users.
- Handles common API errors with suggestions or retry logic.
- Supports multiple languages and platform options.
